question: In a certain code language, 'VIOLET' is written as 'TJMMCU', and 'MARKET' is written as 'KBPLCU'. How will 'ROCKET' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Starting from first letter the alternate letters are subtracted with -2.**

**Starting from second letter the alternate letters are added with +1.**

'VIOLET' is written as 'TJMMCU'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0f2ec026530671ba13e35069e9f43a6bbb1e90dd14df6ae8aea514645b90902.png] 

And

'MARKET' is written as 'KBPLCU'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab6a710a81fbdb33aea1095df73bdb71ded5d6e756d37af3c18a38d391bbf542.png] 

Similarly,

'ROCKET' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e64bcfd5ca3c96d6102ab410a0268ace24e2ee1ac12a195b655bae18e36e26b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PPALCU".**
